**1.038: fewer invented phrases from silence and breaths.**

- A recording with no speech in it, or the very first moment of one, could come back as a phrase nobody said. Hebrish now remembers how loud you usually speak and skips a piece that is far quieter than that and holds almost no speech. It learns the level from your first few dictations, so nothing changes until then.
- A damaged model download is downloaded again instead of failing to load.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
